subject.title: fix: stabilize OpenClaw beta setup and PT-PT formatting

question: Should this PR wait for an official OpenClaw release that contains the validated installDaemon=false wizard contract, or should the independent formatting work be split out now?
rationale: Repository-only review cannot decide when the paired upstream protocol change is suitable for the supported default installation path, and merging before release inclusion can break fresh setup.

options.title: Wait for exact official release
options.body: Keep the PR draft until the upstream contract ships, update the pin to that exact artifact, and rerun the real setup proof against it.

options.title: Split independent formatting
options.body: Land the culture-invariant formatting separately while leaving the setup orchestration and LKG promotion pending upstream release inclusion.

recommendation.title: Wait for exact official release
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft until the upstream contract ships, update the pin to that exact artifact, and rerun the real setup proof against it.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice controls the companion's supported default installation artifact and cross-product setup ownership boundary.
